files.conversation.plain:
ask "What is your name?" into name
say "Hello, " + name + "!"

ask number "How many stars would you like?" into stars

if stars is at least 0 and stars is at most 20
  repeat stars times
    say "*"
  end
else
  say "Try a whole number from 0 to 20 next time."
end

files.counting.plain:
set count to 1

repeat 5 times
  say "Count: " + count
  set count to count + 1
end

say "All done!"

files.main.plain:
set people to [
  {name: "Ada", score: 92},
  {name: "Sam", score: 78},
  {name: "Jo", score: 85}
]

for person at position in people
  say position, person.name, "scored", person.score
end

make score_of(person)
  give person.score
end

say "Scores:", list.map(people, score_of)
say "Average:", list.sum(list.map(people, score_of)) / length(people)
say "The first person:", people[1].name

# Reuse a good idea.
make double(amount)
  give amount * 2
end

make greet(name)
  give "Hello, " + name + "!"
end

say greet("Ada")
say "Double 12 is", double(12)
say "Double a whole list:", list.map([2, 4, 6], double)

files.main.plain:
use "tasks.plain" as tasks

set items to json.read(files.read("tasks.json"))
say "YOUR TASKS"
say "Commands: list, add, done, quit"

while true
  tasks.show(items)
  ask "What would you like to do?" into command
  set command to text.lower(text.trim(command))

  if command is "quit"
    stop
  else if command is "add"
    ask "What do you need to do?" into title
    if text.trim(title) is not ""
      add {title: title, done: false} to items
      say "Task added."
    end
  else if command is "done"
    ask number "Which task number?" into position
    try
      tasks.finish(items, position)
      say "Nice work. Task completed."
    catch issue
      say issue.message
    end
  else if command is not "list"
    say "Try list, add, done, or quit."
  end

  files.write("tasks.json", json.write(items, true))
end

say "Your tasks are saved. See you next time!"
files.tasks.plain:
make show(items)
  if length(items) is 0
    say "No tasks yet. Add your first one."
  end
  for item at position in items
    if item.done
      say position, "[done]", item.title
    else
      say position, "[ ]", item.title
    end
  end
end

make finish(items, position)
  if position is less than 1 or position is more than length(items)
    fail "Choose a task number from the list."
  end
  set items[position].done to true
end
files.tests/tasks.test.plain:
use "../tasks.plain" as tasks

test "a task can be completed"
  set items to [{title: "Learn Plain", done: false}]
  tasks.finish(items, 1)
  check items[1].done is true
end

test "an invalid task number gives a useful error"
  set caught to false
  try
    tasks.finish([], 1)
  catch issue
    set caught to true
    check text.contains(issue.message, "task number")
  end
  check caught is true
end

end

end

end
